🌟 pocketpaw | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a private, self-hosted personal AI assistant that can be easily installed and integrated into their daily communication workflows.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted AI agent • Desktop installer and native app • Web dashboard • Integration with Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, and browser • Support for Anthropic, OpenAI, or Ollama models
📖 Summary: PocketPaw is a self-hosted, open-source personal AI agent designed for quick deployment. It offers a desktop installer and a web dashboard, integrating with various communication platforms and AI models like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Ollama, while prioritizing user data privacy.
